summary: DNS of a slot jet at Re = 495 with a synthetic free-stream turbulence inflow, to t = 100.
description: DNS of a slot jet at Re = 495 from a uniform field, with the synthetic free-stream turbulence inflow of FST_data/FST_inflow.bin. The reference checks the time stamp of the last field and its statistics: the maximum of vx, the minimum of vy and the L2 norms of vx and vy. They are regression values of this repository: a change of the solver, the mesh or the inflow moves them. The values are those of the run named under produced.
note: Regression values of this repository (not literature values). The FST inflow is the shipped FST_data/FST_inflow.bin, so the run is deterministic; the 16 and 32 rank runs agree to the seventh digit.
